RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the December 22, 2008/Pausa 1, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law
and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development)
Total number of questions — 20
96
Regulations for admission and fee
structure of universities and colleges
*281. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee, constituted
by the University Grants Commission
(UGC), to prepare draft regulations for
admission and fee structure in self-financing
universities and colleges, has submitted its
report;
(b) if so,  what are the recommendations
made by the Committee;
(c) whether it is a fact that the Central
Advisory Board on Education (CABE)
Committee on financing of higher education
has also given some recommendations with
regard to the fee structure; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Literacy rate of women
*282. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what is the overall literacy rate of
women in the country, State-wise;
(b) what is the overall literacy rate of
the rural population of women in the
country, State-wise;
(c) what are the main causes of illiteracy
among the rural population of the country;
(d) what steps are being taken to
improve the literacy rate among women in
the country, for betterment of the society;
and
(e) whether Government is planning to
launch any special programmes to improve
the situation, and if so, the details thereof?
Role of public and private sectors in
power generation and distribution
*283. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of  POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether, emphasizing the increased
role for the public sector in power
generation and the private sector in the
distribution business, he has decided to
strengthen technological and managerial
expertise of Public Sector  Undertakings
(PSUs) in power sector and synergize their

97
roles, to complement generation capacity
building efforts;
(b) if so, what are the main suggestions
made to the PSUs in the power sector;
(c) how many of these suggestions have
been considered by those PSUs; and
(d) to what extent the power generation
targets would be achieved during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan?
Opening of Kendriya Vidyalayas
*284. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to open more Kendriya Vidyalayas, and if
so, the details thereof; and
(b) whether in view of direct investment
or industrialization of Kalinganagar-Jajpur
Road in Jajpur District of Orissa,
Government has any plan to open a
Kendriya Vidyalaya at Vyasanagar, Jajpur
Road?
Misuse of laws by women
*285. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the laws enacted for the safety of women,
viz. Dowry Prohibition Act; Protection of
Women from Domestic Violence Act etc.
are being misused by women against their
husbands and in-laws, to mint money and
to harass them;
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
stop such maltreatment of husbands and
their families by their spouses;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether there is any proposal to
enact a law, on the lines of the above laws,
to save husbands and their families from
their spouses;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, whether Government would
take  some action to enact such a law?
Output of Dabhol Power Project
*286. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ:L
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) why the power output from the
erstwhile Dabhol Power Project is
continuing to be erratic; and
(b) by when it would be fully
operational?
Streamlining procedure for cooked
meals to children
*287. DR. JANARDHAN
WAGHMARE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has recently
constituted a Group of Ministers (GoM)
to recommend a procedure, by which all
the country's Anganwadis and Government
sponsored childcare centres would provide
cooked meals to children under the
Integrated Child Development Services
(ICDS) Scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the GoM has been asked to
consult  State Governments also in this
regard; and
(d) if so, by when it is likely to submit
its report to Government?

98
Welfare of street children
*288. SHRI AMBETH RAJAN: Will
the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that a
large number of children in India, mostly in
all the metropolitan cities, and particularly
in Delhi, are staying on the roadside and
selling things at the traffic signals;
(b) if so, what makes them to do so;
(c) whether any step was taken by
Government for the betterment of those
children; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
English medium education in tribal
areas
†*289. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VY AS:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any study has been
conducted regarding the outcome of
education being imparted through the
English medium in the tribal areas;
(b) whether their methods of addressing,
clothing, music, etc. are getting affected;
(c) if so, whether this matter has been
investigated; and
(d) the details of the agency responsible
to see that Indian ideals, great personalities,
moral values are included in the syllabi of
private schools?
Supreme Court ruling on pending
cases
*290. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARW AL: Will the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Supreme
Court has recently taken an initiative to
close cases, including those involving
criminal offences, if the parties reach a
compromise;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether this ruling of the Supreme
Court would allow closure of criminal
proceedings by courts, even in non-
compoundable offences;
(d) if so, what are the reasons for which
Government has not circulated the ruling
to various High Courts, so far, to minimize
the litigations; and
(e) whether Government would
circulate the Supreme Court ruling to
various courts, and if not, the reasons
therefor?
E-governance project of UGC
*291. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Vigilance
Commission (CVC) has since investigated
the e-governance project of the University
Grants Commission (UGC);
(b) if so, the facts and details thereof;
(c) whether any procedural irregularities
have been found in awarding of the project
to a particular firm; and
(d) if so, the corrective steps
Government has taken/proposes to take in
this regard?
Targets under RGGVY
*292. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has achieved
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

99
the target under the Rajiv Gandhi Grameen
Vidyutikaran Yojana (RGGVY), to provide
electricity to 50,000 villages in the country;
(b) if so, how many villages were
electrified till September, 2008, State-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that only six per
cent target has been achieved so far under
the above scheme;
(d) if so, what are the reasons for slow
work under the scheme; and
(e) the action being taken in this regard,
as on date ?
Disposal of pending cases
†*293. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that, in view of
the increasing number of court cases, the
Chief Justice of India has  also stressed the
need to set up more benches of Supreme
Court and to increase the number of CBI
courts, along with other courts;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
number of pending cases in family courts
as well is increasing; and
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to ensure the rapid disposal
of pending cases?
De-addiction centres at panchayat
level
†*294. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARW AL: W ill the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes
to implement a centrally sponsored
scheme for setting up de-addiction
centres at gram panchayat level in the
country;
(b) if so, the details of de-addiction
centres to be established, State-wise and
location-wise;
(c) whether any financial allocation was
made for this purpose during the last three
years, till date;
(d) if so, the details thereof; State-wise;
and
(e) the details of its achievement during
the said period, State-wise?
Problems in power sector
*295. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
 SANGHI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has decided to
have a meeting with the power project
developers, in the wake of ongoing financial
crisis;
(b) whether a Prime Minister's panel
has been set up to study the credit crunch
in the power sector;
(c) whether the National Thermal Power
Corporation (NTPC) is said to have
achieved capacity addition target;
(d) whether Dabhol power output has
fallen at  300 MW;
(e) if so, what were the main points
suggested during the meeting; and
(f) what are the concrete measures taken
by Government to help power projects to
achieve their targets?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

100
Internal assurance cell in universities
and colleges
*296. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the University Grants
Commission (UGC) has asked  all the
universities and colleges in the country to
have an internal assurance cell, to improve
the quality of higher education being
imparted;
(b) if so, whether all the Central
Universities and colleges are monitored by
the UGC, in so far as imparting of higher
education is concerned;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) what other steps Government
proposes to take to improve standard of
education in colleges and universities, in
consultation with the State Governments?
Appointment of judges to Supreme
Court
*297. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court's panel,
responsible for appointments and
promotions of judges to the Supreme Court,
has rejected Government's objections to its
latest round of recommendations for
promotions;
(b) the reasons for Government's refusal
and asking the Chief Justice of India to
reconsider the names for elevation; and
(c) whether it has escalated the conflict
between Judiciary and the Parliament, and
if so, the details in this regard?
Rural electrification
†*298. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the rural area villages are
covered under the electrification programme
for the revenue village;
(b) if so, whether under the revenue
village, all the villages coming within a 20
km radius are being electrified;
(c) if so, the details in this regard
pertaining to Jharkhand;
(d) whether Government is aware that
contractors are covering villages coming
only within a 5 km radius for electrification
under the revenue village; and
(e) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
World Bank fund for SSA
*299. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI : Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has entered
into a financial agreement with the World
Bank to provide assistance worth $600
million, to fund the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan
(SSA);
(b) if so, the facts and details  thereof;
(c) whether the second phase of SSA
has since been  commissioned, with the
financial assistance of the World Bank;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) in what manner the financial
assistance sought from the World Bank is
being utilised?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

101
Over-regulation of higher
education
*300. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 16th December, 2008 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 25, 1930 (Saka)
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state the time by when the
over-regulation of higher education
sector, which hurts the honest and
indirectly abets the dishonest institutions,
would end?
